faq.q: Which mail does it work with?
faq.a: Gmail and Outlook. Each person connects their own mailbox.

faq.q: Does it ever send anything on its own?
faq.a: No. Every reply waits for you to press Send, or to pick a time for it to go.
None of your mail. With People map added, they see who on the team knows someone and when you last spoke, never what was said, and you can turn that off.

faq.q: What if it files something wrong?
faq.a: Move it. Your last twenty moves are the examples every later read learns from.

faq.q: How far back does it read?
faq.a: About the last month when you set it up, then everything new. For older mail, ask your Lemma: it searches Gmail or Outlook directly.

faq.q: Can I try it before connecting my mail?
faq.a: Yes. Try it live on this page, or set it up on a sample mailbox of made-up mail.

landing.closing: Open your inbox to replies already written.
